svg.title: Preservation loss and behavioral diagnostics
svg.desc: The same five tested weights are shown in three panels: weighted KL divided by CE, adapter displacement, and teacher-correct agreement. Each point is an observed aggregate. No curve is fitted.

g.text: Loss share is not preservation strength
Five 50-update TRAIN-only probes, summarized after warmup. No accuracy claim follows from this sweep.

g.text: Discrete tested weights are equally spaced. Teacher agreement was not recorded for W = 0.
W = 8 produces the smallest adapter displacement and highest teacher agreement, despite a lower loss ratio than W = 2.
